account: Today I have found administrative gaps, but no confirmed secret activity. I verified 128 emeralds in the treasury; outstanding commitments remain unknown, and no spending was authorized during the accounts review. The secretary reports that all four great-hall table chests are empty, with no accounts ledger or commitments register, and does not know who kept the previous ledger. That is missing documentation, not evidence of theft or absence of obligations. The builder reportedly found no confirmed defects in visual checks of the bridge, landing, and warehouse approach. The innkeeper wants visitor and meeting numbers for this week's rooms and meals, apparently to plan provisions, but named no specific occasion or date. Freight offered transport quotations if quantities and destinations become known. My neighbour reported no unusual riverside activity during tea. I heard some distant conversations but could not make out their words, so cannot infer their purpose. The secretary filed the accounts review and treasury update, retains my appointment book, and came to my home this evening requesting stationery for a written report. My attempted transfer of one emerald failed, so none was delivered. The late visit is somewhat unusual, but the stated purpose is routine reporting. I still have a feeling something may be happening without my knowledge, but nothing observed today establishes a hidden gathering or scheme. Tomorrow I should read the appointment book, attend office at eight and the mill grain inspection at ten, and pursue the records gap without treating speculation as fact.
